recipes.name: Avocado Garlic Cream
instructions: Add all the ingredients to a small food processor* and blend until creamy. Enjoy with nourish bowls, in wraps, in sandwiches, or as a dip!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * Alternatively, mash the avocados, crush the garlic, and mix the ingredients in a bowl.
Storage Best to enjoy this sauce as soon as it's made.
